messages:
maya: Quick Q — I'm relocating SF -> Singapore with an expected move_date of 2026-07-10. How does PTO accrual and holiday observance switch? Do I keep US floating holidays or switch to SG bank holidays? Need to sync with payroll.
sarah-peopleops: Congrats on the move! You’ll switch to the local holiday calendar effective your first local workday. Accruals are pro-rated based on which policy applies on each day. I’ll DM the checklist. @ryan-payroll can confirm payroll cutover details. :tada:
ryan-payroll: Hi Maya — need the official move date + new location by payroll cutoff (2026-06-25 for July pay). For accruals we do: prorate up to 2026-07-09 under US plan, 2026-07-10 onward under SG plan. Unused US floating holidays don’t auto-convert — you can request payout or one-time conversion per policy.
maya: Got it. One follow-up: do sick day buckets stay the same globally or split? And can statutory SG holidays be converted into floaters if I prefer?
sarah-peopleops: Sick accrual stays per your employment contract (no automatic split). Local statutory holidays are applied based on work location — they don’t become US floaters. We do offer a one-time conversion option: up to 5 unused US floaters -> 2 SG flex days (approval required). I’ll include the conversion form link in the DM.
tom-manager: Manager note — please ensure coverage for the sprint week of 2026-07-15 to 2026-07-19. Maya, can you confirm your last US working day so we can schedule handover? :calendar:
maya: My last full US workday will be 2026-07-09 (remote). I’ll be traveling 7/10 and will be on SG hours starting 7/11. I’ll put together a short handover doc and link it here.
sarah-peopleops: Filing accrual-change request and cc'ing payroll now. Policy excerpt for reference:
```
Change of work location policy (snippet):
- accrual cutover date = first local workday
- payroll cutover = next payroll cycle after HR notification
- request relocation form: https://hr.redwood/relocate
- conversion caps and approvals documented on the form
```
people-ops-bot: Reminder: relocation form submitted? If not, please complete to avoid payroll/manual adjustments.
ryan-payroll: Note on payroll ops — if relocation notice misses cutoff we can run a manual adjustment: run_jobs.sh --adjust-accrual --employee 12345 --effective 2026-07-10. Provide employee ID in HR form.
maya: Thanks everyone — filing relocation form now and DMing @sarah-peopleops the docs. Will post the handover link once it's ready.
